name: login-04
title: Login 04
description: A card that opens into two columns: the form, and a kraft panel with three drawn polaroids taped and pinned to it. Three provider buttons in a row. The pictures stay home below 42rem. Made for the desk.
docs:
Installed the "Login 04" block into your components directory under blocks/login-04/.
Import it: import Login04Page from "<your components alias>/blocks/login-04/page"
Needs @hookform/resolvers@^5, react-hook-form@^7, zod@^4: the CLI installs them (a project on an older major is upgraded).
